gate: No Rust compile/discovery/run or GUI build before fixed head/manifest review. Source parsing, rustfmt, offline lock/metadata and static checks only now.
preflight: Use current room blocking exclusive flock for every write/build/cache access. Recheck git status and pinned inputs inside lock.
Verify 95 source Git blobs/modes/SHA256 and new manifest. Use installed Rust 1.99.1 and existing cache, locked/offline only.
Dedicated target and fresh exclusive validation directory under this tests path, canonical and owned. Refuse reuse after failure.
Native Linux only. Record installed Noto file metadata/size <=32MiB and SHA256 before/after; never save font bytes.
Original UI full manifest remains a pre-PR52 historical pin. source-pins.json is the explicit new overlay; do not weaken or claim passage of the old full check against changed app.rs.
order: Group1 compile/discover/run then group2. Validate complete unique exact discovery sets, run sorted names once. Require 1 passed/0 failed/0 ignored/0 measured and the per-group filtered count. Stop first error, missing record, timeout or changed input; no retry or expectation/source change.
supervision: Parent streams capped raw logs. Deadline/overflow signals only owned process group, then bounded wait/reap and pipe EOF. Never assert signals interrupt uninterruptible I/O. Unconfirmed state is failure.
cleanup: No font/production writes or new fixtures. Retain own logs and target artifacts, verify owned children ended. Never erase failed or historical evidence.
evidence: Record argv/cwd/allowlisted env, toolchain, binaries SHA256, source/font before-after hashes, exact discovered/executed/filtered names, raw logs, PIDs/wait/EOF/residuals and evidence class. Loader is real file-read evidence; UI is reused headless regression; AppCreation errors stay static-only.
deferred_gui: Production GUI build and separated Xvfb startup/rendering need a later explicit execution scope. PR47 harness has its own loader and cannot validate this loader.
forbidden: real archives or OS worker/held probes
